official: 東京都板橋区児童福祉施設の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例

name: 児童福祉施設の資格要件を変更
summary: 児童福祉施設では、施設の長や職員になれる資格が条例で定められています。この議案では、一部の資格要件にこども家庭ソーシャルワーカーなどを加え、別の要件から社会福祉士や精神保健福祉士を削るなどします。
changes: 一部の施設長・職員の資格要件にこども家庭ソーシャルワーカーを加える
2つの職員資格要件に精神保健福祉士を加える
一部の職員資格要件から社会福祉士・精神保健福祉士を削る
who: 児童福祉施設の長や職員、就職を希望する人
why: 内閣府令の改正に伴い、一部の児童福祉施設の長や職員の資格要件に資格を加えるなど、規定を整える必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes qualification requirements for child welfare facility heads and staff
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Equipment and Operation of Child Welfare Facilities in Itabashi City, Tokyo
en.summary: The qualifications required to become a head or staff member of a child welfare facility are set out in an ordinance. This bill adds qualifications such as Child and Family Social Worker to some requirements, and removes Certified Social Worker and Certified Psychiatric Social Worker from another requirement.
changes: Adds Child and Family Social Worker to some qualification requirements for facility heads and staff
Adds Certified Psychiatric Social Worker to two staff qualification requirements
Removes Certified Social Worker and Certified Psychiatric Social Worker from some staff qualification requirements
who: Heads and staff of child welfare facilities, and people seeking those jobs
Staff of child welfare facilities, and people seeking those jobs
Staff of child welfare facilities, and people seeking those jobs
en.why: The ward says the provisions need to be revised, including by adding qualifications to the requirements for some heads and staff of child welfare facilities, following an amendment to a Cabinet Office Order.
